figurative_meaning_bn: অপেক্ষা করলে লাভ আছে; শেষপর্যন্ত লাভ হয়
figurative_meaning_en: There is benefit in waiting; eventually, profit comes
similar_in_english: Good things come to those who wait
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় কিছু সময় লাগলেও আখেরে লাভ হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Be patient, there will be profit in the end.
The business took time, but in the end, it paid off.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali wisdom emphasizing perseverance.
